episodes.title: Du är varnad
episodes.summary: Malmö detectives Dani and Malik pay an unwelcome visit to a rural village to investigate the disappearance of a teenager — only for Dani, it's personal.

episodes.title: Okänd man nr 1
episodes.summary: Questions mount in the case as fresh evidence and buried secrets surface. Dani and Malik pursue multiple leads to track down an unknown suspect.

episodes.title: Bröder
episodes.summary: Malik bends the rules to help a heartbroken colleague deal with a painful prospect. Elis confronts a menacing figure from his past.

episodes.title: Järven
episodes.summary: While Järven issues an ultimatum to secure his safety, Elis forms an unlikely alliance to prove a potentially dangerous theory.

episodes.title: Bidrottningen
episodes.summary: As unsettling new evidence and hard truths come to light, both police and locals scramble to find those responsible — before it's too late.
